width:100%; height:100%; box-sizing:border-box; color:#f8fafc; font-size:13px; text-align:left; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
div.b: FIGURE 3: SYSTEM-BEHAVIOUR FINITE STATE MACHINE (Moore Machine)
div.span: Classification: Moore — Outputs determined solely by current state, not input events. Justification: Each state has deterministic physical outputs (RF field, display content, buzzer voltage, LED state) regardless of entry path, simplifying formal verification and safety analysis.

div.style: width:100%; height:100%; box-sizing:border-box; color:#ecfdf5; font-size:10px; text-align:center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;

width:100%; height:100%; box-sizing:border-box; color:#fef2f2; font-size:10px; text-align:center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;

width:100%; height:100%; box-sizing:border-box; color:#f8fafc; font-size:11px; text-align:center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
div.span:
OLED: "Initializing..."
RF: OFF | Buzzer: 0V
Wi-Fi: AP Starting | LED: Blink

div.style: width:100%; height:100%; box-sizing:border-box; color:#ecfdf5; font-size:11px; text-align:center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
div.span:
OLED: "Waiting for tag..."
RF: Carrier ON (13.56 MHz polling)
Buzzer: 0V | LED: Solid ON
Crypto1: STOPPED | Files: CLOSED

div.style: width:100%; height:100%; box-sizing:border-box; color:#f8fafc; font-size:11px; text-align:center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
div.span:
OLED: Updating...
RF: Anti-collision active
Buzzer: 0V | LED: ON
Timer: startTime = micros()

div.style: width:100%; height:100%; box-sizing:border-box; color:#e0e7ff; font-size:11px; text-align:center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
div.span:
OLED: "Authenticating..."
RF: Crypto-1 session active
Buzzer: 0V | LED: ON
Deadline: 35,000 µs

div.style: width:100%; height:100%; box-sizing:border-box; color:#fef2f2; font-size:11px; text-align:center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
div.span:
OLED: Error message displayed
RF: Carrier OFF (PICC_HaltA)
Buzzer: 500 Hz × 200 ms
LED: Fast Blink
PCD_StopCrypto1() executed

div.style: width:100%; height:100%; box-sizing:border-box; color:#fef3c7; font-size:11px; text-align:center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
div.span:
OLED: Scan result (UID, time, auth)
RF: PICC_HaltA issued
Buzzer: 1 kHz × 100 ms (success)
LED: Solid ON
LittleFS: file.flush() committed

div.style: width:100%; height:100%; box-sizing:border-box; color:#94a3b8; font-size:9px; text-align:left; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-start; padding-top: 6px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;

foreignObject.div: State Transition Completeness: Every state has at least one outgoing transition. S4_FAULT always recovers to S1_IDLE (safe state). Self-loop on S1_IDLE handles async HTTP events without state change. No undefined or dangling transitions exist.
